whyRefusedFallsThrough.rootCause: TWO separate defects stack, not one. (1) attachVerdictLayersToFacets (structuralFactToFacetsWire.ts:216) gates its entire parcel_record-wins branch on `parcelRecordZoningFact.state !== "refused"`. When the zoningDistrict rail's own cell is kind=refused, zoningFactFromParcelRecord.ts wraps it as ZoningFactRefusal ({state:"refused", code:"parcel-record-engine-refused", entityId, reason}) -- and that whole shape is EXCLUDED from ever reaching `out.zoning`. Execution falls to the `else if (zoningVerdict...)` branch instead, which sets out.zoning to the city-limits-derived fallback (verdict:"stamp-missing"), discarding the rail's real, specific reason entirely. (2) zoningSourceMirror (same file, ~line 102) has three branches (district-with-citation, city-limits-shaped absence, parcel_record ZoningFactAbsent) -- none matches a ZoningFactRefusal shape ({state:"refused",...}, no `absence` key, no `verdict` key at all), so even if out.zoning DID carry it, the mirror would return undefined today, not verbatim-copy it.
whyRefusedFallsThrough.whyBothMustFix: Because of defect (1), out.zoning never becomes the ZoningFactRefusal shape in the first place -- it becomes CITY_LIMITS-style {status:"absent",verdict:"stamp-missing",...}. zoningSourceMirror's branch 2 (`typeof rec.verdict==="string" && rec.status==="absent"`) THEN matches that fallback shape and mirrors "stamp-missing" verbatim onto provenance.zoningSource. That is the literal path to the observed defect: both facets.zoning.verdict and provenance.zoningSource.verdict end up "stamp-missing", which is not in verify-walk.mjs's ABSENCE_STATE_TOKENS (only absent-verified/not-applicable/refused), so classifyRequiredLeaf grades it unrecognised-declared-state, ok:false, on BOTH required leaves (`zoning` and `provenance.zoningSource` are both in REQUIRED_TIER1_FACET_PATHS, confirmed by reading verify-walk.mjs live at P:/tmp/ctx-w2-gate, HEAD 7a53c65, confirmed 0 commits behind origin/main).
whyRefusedFallsThrough.graderRead: Reproduced classifyRequiredLeaf verbatim from the live P:/tmp/ctx-w2-gate/src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs (confirmed current, not stale, via git fetch + rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main = 0 for this file). Key finding: the ABSENCE_STATE_TOKENS 'refused' branch (line 368) grades {state:"refused",ok:true} UNCONDITIONALLY -- it does not check basis/reason/scope the way absent-verified and not-applicable do. So the fix does not need a reason to PASS the grader; it needs one to be honest, per this program's own 'every absence carries its basis' house rule, and the dispatch's explicit instruction to carry it.
